# loghry.org

> The Loghry family lives in Seattle. One aerial photograph of Lake Union, looking south toward downtown, redrawn for the hour, season and typical weather it is in Seattle right now.

- The page always follows Seattle time (America/Los_Angeles), never the visitor's clock.
- Sun and moon positions are computed in the browser. The sky is typical weather for that hour, chosen from Sea-Tac 1991–2020 climate normals; everyone sees the same sky at the same hour. It is not a forecast.
- The site is fully static: no server, no API, no analytics, no third-party requests.
- Photo: Ryan Wilson on Unsplash. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

## Pages

- [Home](https://loghry.org/): the living photograph and an almanac of today's light, the year in Seattle's daylight, and a typical month.
